rows.title: Film Review: A Chinese Ghost Story (1987) by Ching Siu-tung
rows.comment: but also poetic in its inventive subtlety
rows.verdict_le10: but also poetic in its inventive subtlety
rows.dek_lead: The movie is entertaining and enjoyable in terms of action set pieces, but also poetic in its inventive subtlety. All things considered, “A Chinese Ghost Story” is a cinematic tale unlike any other.

rows.title: A Chinese Ghost Story 1987, directed by Ching Siu-Tung | Film review
rows.dek_lead: The storyline is a Ming Dynasty chestnut about a wandering scholar who falls in love with a glamorous female ghost, only to find the hordes of hell on his tail. Low points include the scenes in town, with market stallholder
